name: Personal Agenda
description: Save personal events and appointments with their dates.

create_event.description: Create a personal agenda event from an explicit plan, appointment, or activity with a date.

event_date.description: The event date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

event_time.description: The optional event time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

create_task.description: Create one or more personal tasks, optionally scheduled for a specific date.

task_titles.description: The task titles to add to the personal task list.

task_date.description: The optional task date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
